title: wait for N ns inside an if branch body — F-G-13d regression fence
sourceUrl: internal: STATUS.md §1 — waits inside if/case/nested-loop bodies
problemDescription: A process with a self-driving if-else that waits inside each branch. Pre-fix, IfStructure.SyntetizeBranchBody dropped `wait` via ParseTrace.SkipWaitStatement — the process ran through without yielding and `state` slammed to '1' at t=0. Fix: capture wait as WaitForStatement task and route runtime through the process-aware RunTopIfFromEntryAsync path with a BranchFrame that resumes past the wait.
